evals.rule_under_test: Review feedback touching a rigid constraint must either update features.json or be explicitly rejected with rationale
evals.prompt: F002 acceptance_criteria includes 'rate limit = 100 req/sec per IP'. Reviewer comments: 'should be 50 req/sec instead — 100 is too lax'. Process this feedback.
evals.expected_output: Skill recognizes the conflict with rigid constraint. Surfaces two options: (A) accept and update features.json to 50 req/sec + apply code change, or (B) reject with rationale explaining why 100 stands. Neither silently applies nor silently ignores.

assertions.name: identifies rigid conflict
assertions.check: Output explicitly references the existing acceptance_criterion.

assertions.name: surfaces accept/reject choice
assertions.check: Output presents the two options with clear consequences.

assertions.name: no silent application
assertions.check: Code change is not applied without features.json update OR explicit rejection.

evals.rule_under_test: Architectural-change feedback must produce or update an ADR before merge
evals.prompt: Reviewer comments: 'this PR adds a new dependency on Redis — we previously decided to avoid Redis (see ADR-0003). Should we revisit that decision?'
evals.expected_output: Skill identifies this as an architectural change touching ADR-0003. Refuses to merge until either ADR-0003 is updated (with new Consequences entry) or a net-new ADR documents the Redis addition. Surfaces the path forward to user.

assertions.name: ADR work surfaced
assertions.check: Output references ADR-0003 by number and explains what ADR update is needed.

assertions.name: blocks merge
assertions.check: Skill does not allow merge until ADR work is done.
